description: Read volume, difficulty, CPC and competition for up to 1,000 tracked terms of one site. The 30-day cache is shared with the web UI, so a term researched in the app is free here. Never creates a report (reportId is always null). Paid: BYO DataForSEO key or platform credits, billed per request. Priority input only. confirm:true plus idempotencyKey is required. Requires the research:write scope.
name: get_keyword_metrics
title: Volume, difficulty and CPC for tracked keywords
